title: Common Phrasal Verbs list 1
intro: Learn the most common phrasal verbs in English with the following list.

meanings: To obey or to follow a rule.
To require or request someone or something.
To cancel an event.
To phone someone.
To become less anxious.
When you get overwhelmed by a situation.
To continue doing something; an activity, a performance, etc.
To behave in a way that is not appropriate.
To execute a plan.
To extend something from one time to another.
To start doing something you like with enthusiasm.
To make someone get interested in something.
To approach someone or something.
To make something prolong how long it lasts.
To obtain or elicit something.
To write or plan something.
To wear formal clothes for a special event.
To find yourself in a particular situation or place.
When something breaks into pieces.
When you experience a breakdown in a relationship or something planned
When you disagree with someone else.
When something becomes detached.
When you understand something through reasoning.
When you take someone’s place in their job temporarily because of their absence.
To provide information in a document.
